items.q: What exactly is the Celestial Oracle?
items.a: The Celestial Oracle is a mythological reading system that pairs each birth month with one of twelve legendary creatures, drawn from a blend of classical zodiac lore and original myth. It is a work of storytelling and reflection, not a scientific or predictive instrument.

The Oracle uses a combination of Hermetic principles and zodiac studies, reimagined through original myth. Its accuracy, like any archetypal system, depends largely on your willingness to look inward and see where the reflection resonates.

items.q: Is the Oracle based on real astrology?
items.a: Loosely. The four realms map onto the four classical elements (fire, earth, air, water) and the underlying month-to-sign pairings follow the traditional zodiac calendar, but the creatures, artifacts, and lore themselves are original inventions of the Oracle.

items.q: Can my creature change over time?
items.a: While your birth creature remains your core essence, your Spirit Guide may evolve as you undergo major spiritual transformations. Many Oracle-keepers report a shift in which guide feels 'active' during different chapters of life.

items.q: What if I was born on a cusp?
items.a: Those born within three days of a month's start or end may possess secondary traits of the adjacent month's creature. Consult both readings and notice which details feel more familiar — most cusp-born visitors find they carry a blend of the two.

items.q: Can I consult the Oracle more than once?
items.a: Yes. Every page with the Oracle's gate lets you reveal your destiny as many times as you like, for yourself or to compare with a different month out of curiosity.

items.q: Why does my aura color change the whole page?
items.a: Each creature carries a signature aura drawn from its ruling planet and element. When your reading is revealed, that color washes gently through the page as a visual signature of your particular resonance.

The Ignis Realm (Fire), the Terra Realm (Earth), the Aether Realm (Air), and the Abyss Realm (Water). Every one of the twelve creatures belongs to exactly one realm, and the realm shapes their broad temperament.

items.q: Do the artifacts and symbols mean anything specific?
items.a: They are treated as energetic imprints rather than literal objects — a way of naming a talent or inner tool a person already carries, given a shape that's easier to hold in the imagination.

items.q: Why does my Spirit Guide matter?
items.a: The guide is described in Oracle lore as a mirror for the quality your creature most needs to stay balanced. It is less an oracle in its own right and more a quiet companion figure for reflection.

items.q: Is my birth month stored anywhere?
items.a: No. The Oracle runs entirely in your browser. Your selection is used only to look up your reading in a local data file and is never saved, transmitted, or stored anywhere.

items.q: The Oracle doesn't recognize the month I typed — why?
items.a: Try typing the full month name or its first three letters (for example 'Aug' or 'August'). The Oracle's free-text gate accepts common abbreviations but not numerals outside 1 through 12.

items.q: Is this meant to be taken literally?
items.a: The Oracle is offered as a work of myth, reflection, and entertainment. It is a lens for thinking about your own tendencies through story, not a claim about destiny, personality science, or the future.
